from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///developments.db'
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

class Development(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(80), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)

@app.route('/update_development', methods=['POST'])
def update_development():
    development_id = request.form['development_id']
    title = request.form['title']
    description = request.form['description']

    query = "UPDATE developments SET title=:title, description=:description WHERE id=:id"
    db.session.execute(query, {"id": development_id, "title": title, "description": description})
    db.session.commit()

    return jsonify({'status': 'ok'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()
